howToEdit: Drag and drop players to form teams.

summary.counts: {complete, plural, =0 {No complete teams} one {# complete team} other {# complete teams}}, {incomplete, plural, =0 {no incomplete teams} one {# incomplete team} other {# incomplete teams}}, and {reserves, plural, =0 {no reserves} one {# reserve} other {# reserves}}.
summary.started: {teams, plural, one {# team} other {# teams}} in the bracket and {reserves, plural, =0 {no reserves} one {# reserve} other {# reserves}}.
summary.rule: The tournament starts with at least {min} complete teams.

draw.title: Draw teams
draw.what: Redoes all teams. Whoever registered last and doesn't complete a team becomes a reserve.
draw.whatCheckIn: Redoes all teams with players who checked in. Whoever registered last and doesn't complete a team becomes a reserve.
draw.balancedHint: Teams with similar average rating, based on the community rating. The captain is the highest-rated player.
draw.confirm: Draw again? Current teams, with names and captains, and the seeding will be undone.
draw.short: The draw needs at least {size} registered; {count, plural, =0 {none so far} one {only # is registered} other {only # are registered}}.
draw.shortCheckIn: The draw uses only players who checked in and needs at least {size}; {count, plural, =0 {nobody has yet} one {only # has} other {only # have}}.

teams.title: Teams ({count})
teams.newTeam: Drop here to create a new team

state.missing: {count, plural, one {# player missing} other {# players missing}}
state.out: out: no one in the community

rename.title: Rename {name}
rename.label: Team name
rename.helper: Without a name, the team appears as “{fallback}”.

captain.title: Change captain of {name}
captain.hint: The captain names the team, can rename it, and, per the tournament rules, acts for it in matches.
captain.label: Captain

substitute.title: Substitute player in {name}
substitute.hint: Applies from the next submitted game. The player leaving becomes a reserve.
substitute.noCandidates: There are no reserves or other active community members to join.

withdraw.confirm: Mark {name} as withdrawn? The team's current and upcoming matches become walkovers for the opponent. This can't be undone.

howToEditTouch: Use the ⋯ menu on each player to form teams.
